data.title: Canopy Growth Announces Adjournment of 2026 Annual General and Special Meeting Due to Lack of Quorum
data.description: Canopy Growth Corporation, a prominent global cannabis company listed on the TSX and Nasdaq as WEED and CGC respectively, revealed that their Annual General and Special Meeting of shareholders, initially planned for September 25, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. ET via live webcast, had to be adjourned due to the lack of the required quorum. The company announced that the Meeting will resume on the same day.

data.title: Rubico Announces Record Date of Monday, September 28 and Ex-Dividend Date of Tuesday, October 6 for Previously-Announced 0.50 Common Shares Per Common Share Stock Dividend
data.description: Rubico Inc. (Nasdaq: RUBI), a global shipping transportation services provider, has announced a stock dividend of 0.50 common shares for each outstanding common share. The ex-dividend date is set for October 6, 2026, with the Stock Dividend distribution on or around October 5, 2026, to shareholders as of record on September 28, 2026. No partial shares will be issued; instead, cash payments will be made for any fractional shares based on the closing price of Rubico's common shares on Nasdaq on September 28, 2026.

data.title: BAYSTATE HEALTH ANNOUNCES PARTICIPATION IN NATIONAL CLINICAL TRIAL FOR ADVANCED BRAIN ANEURYSM TREATMENT
data.description: Springfield-based Baystate Health revealed today its selection to partake in a pioneering national clinical trial for Advanced Brain Aneurysm treatment. The hospital enrolled the first patients in the country for this trial. This significant development was made public on September 25, 2026.

data.title: The Fashion Institute of Technology (FIT) Announces 'FIT Future//Forward Conversations,' A Series of Live Talks with the Individuals Shaping the Global Creative Industries
data.description: In a recent update on September 25, 2026, the Fashion Institute of Technology (FIT) disclosed new public programming as part of FIT Future//Forward. This initiative was introduced by FIT President in alignment with the State University of New York (SUNY). FIT, renowned for providing creative education on a global scale, unveiled these latest offerings to enhance its strategic approach.
